Blue Dart Apex & Delhivery Air transit SLAs
Integer minor units in paise with en-IN formatting

userStories.title: Automated Testing Suite & Code Review Quality Gates
userStories.description: As a release manager, I want 100% automated test coverage on security, pricing, and logistics.

userStories.title: Admin Route-Level Defense-in-Depth Session Protection
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want all /api/admin/* endpoints to strictly enforce requireAdminSession at the route handler level.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 admin API endpoints validate session token and signature at handler level
Unauthorized requests return HTTP 401 even if edge middleware is bypassed
userStories.notes: Implemented requireAdminSession in src/lib/auth.ts and applied across products, orders, settings, and audit admin route handlers.

userStories.title: Durable Database Webhook Deduplication & Atomic Transactions
userStories.description: As a payment specialist, I want webhooks deduplicated via PostgreSQL AuditLog and state updates bundled in an atomic transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Durable database deduplication via AuditLog prevents duplicate credits across serverless instances
Payment and order state updates execute in an atomic $transaction
userStories.notes: Switched webhook to shared @/lib/prisma, implemented AuditLog eventId deduplication, atomic transaction, and amount mismatch checks.

userStories.title: Pluggable Carrier-Agnostic Logistics & Shiprocket Adapter
userStories.description: As an operations lead, I want a carrier-agnostic logistics abstraction with Shiprocket and deterministic sandbox mock mode.
acceptanceCriteria: ShippingProvider interface with serviceability, shipment creation, tracking, and cancellation
ShiprocketShippingAdapter with token caching and JWT auth
Deterministic Sandbox Mock Mode fallback for safe testing without carrier wallet billing
userStories.notes: Engineered src/lib/shipping/types.ts and src/lib/shipping/shiprocket.ts with Blue Dart Apex & Delhivery Air mapping and full mock fallback.

userStories.title: Distributed Rate Limiter & Trusted Proxy IP Extraction
userStories.description: As a DevSecOps engineer, I want rate limiting hardened against IP spoofing and supporting distributed Redis.
acceptanceCriteria: Hardened client IP extraction prioritizing cf-connecting-ip and x-vercel-forwarded-for with regex validation
Optional Upstash Redis REST distributed limiter with fallback to in-memory sliding window
Timer unref on interval for clean node exit
userStories.notes: Enhanced src/lib/rate-limit.ts with trusted header hierarchy, Upstash Redis REST check, unref interval, and strict route profiles.

userStories.title: Private Route Intermediary Cache Hardening
userStories.description: As a security architect, I want private user and admin routes explicitly prevented from caching on intermediate CDNs.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate headers on /api/admin/*, /api/orders/*, /admin/*, /checkout, /bag, /profile, /saved
Pragma: no-cache set for legacy proxies
userStories.notes: Configured private route Cache-Control headers in next.config.js preventing intermediary caching of orders, bag, and admin state.
